summary: REPORT-ONLY forensic audit of Rahaza Travel ERP completed. Tested login and UI flows for 3 roles (owner, ops, driver). All logins work. Most modules render without crash. Key finding: RBAC leakage — driver role can access full management interface including Bookings, Settings, and other owner/ops-only modules.

backend_issues.notes: Backend APIs responding correctly (200 OK). No backend testing was performed as this is a frontend-only audit per request.

rbac_observations.issue: Driver role has access to full management interface
rbac_observations.details: Driver can access: Bookings management (/app/bookings with full table), Settings (/app/settings), Armada (/app/vehicles), and other management modules. Driver sidebar shows: Beranda, Booking & Trip, Ruang Kerja Driver, GPS Tracking, Maintenance, Armada, Driver.
rbac_observations.expected: Driver should only see driver-focused workspace (Ruang Kerja Driver) with their own trips/tasks, not full management modules

passed_tests: Login works for all 3 roles: owner@demo.local, ops@demo.local, driver@demo.local (password: demo12345)
OWNER role: Dashboard (Control Tower) renders with onboarding checklist and metrics
OWNER role: Bookings module renders OK, create booking dialog opens successfully
OWNER role: Dispatch module renders OK
OWNER role: CRM module renders OK
OWNER role: Maintenance module renders OK
OWNER role: Reports module renders OK
OWNER role: Inbox module renders OK
OPS role: Login successful, dashboard renders
OPS role: Bookings module accessible and renders OK
OPS role: Dispatch module accessible and renders OK
OPS role: Customers module accessible and renders OK
OPS role: Settings link NOT visible in sidebar (RBAC working for ops)
DRIVER role: Login successful, dashboard renders
DRIVER role: Driver workspace (Ruang Kerja Driver) accessible and renders with task cards (3 total tasks, 2 active, 1 completed, 1 needs POD)
No console errors detected during testing
UI is clean, professional, and in Indonesian language
All pages load without blank screens or red error screens

critical: FIX RBAC LEAKAGE (O-1): Driver role can access full management interface (Bookings, Settings, Vehicles, Drivers). Implement proper role-based route guards in frontend (ProtectedRoute component) and verify backend API endpoints enforce role restrictions.
high: VERIFY: Some owner modules (Quotations, Finance, Settings) navigation links not found by test selectors — may be in submenus or have different text. Manually verify these are accessible to owner role.
notes: WhatsApp provider is MOCKED by design (no real sends) — this is expected, not a bug
Geocoding/OSRM returns null offline by design (no outbound network) — this is expected, not a bug
Known backend bugs (quotation PDF 500, CRM segment preview 500, CMS create 500) were NOT tested per audit scope
Drag-and-drop, camera, file/photo upload (POD photo) were SKIPPED per audit instructions (browser automation limitation)

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (login and most modules work, but RBAC leakage is critical)
